issues.description: The public method that triggers singing the farm song is named singFarmSong() in the problem statement and in the template, but the solution implementation provides a method named playFarmSong() instead. This identifier mismatch (singFarmSong vs playFarmSong) is likely to confuse students comparing their implementation to the solution or when tests or graders expect singFarmSong(), and may lead to difficulty locating the intended entry point for playing the song.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method name across artifacts. Rename the solution's public method playFarmSong() to singFarmSong() (and keep its implementation calling the private singFarmSongVerse(Animal) per animal). Alternatively, update the problem statement and template to refer to playFarmSong() instead of singFarmSong(), but keeping singFarmSong() as the public API (matching the problem and template) is the least disruptive fix.
